body:
PR #8 round 2 is APPROVED at 48a8dfa. It has a supervised hold, so it ships when the operator clears it.

PR #9 at 3fdcdc2: CHANGES. Read it with aida review verdict STORY-79 (aida-host). The base case works end to end. Blocking:
(1) Freshness ignores args, env, subcommand and target. check/test after build, RUSTFLAGS changes and --target-dir changes each ran a full unslotted compile. Use a stamp keyed on a hash of the normalized args plus relevant env.
(2) min_ref_ns uses the OLDEST .d, so edit+build then rerun never goes fresh; it is always not-fresh on ~/ai/aida.
(3) No history counts as fresh, and run/bench are never budget-checked. No history must mean queue.
(4) The fresh.lock fd leaks to children (no CLOEXEC; ADR-25).
(5) The stderr tee removes the child's TTY, writes an unbounded tmpfs file and gives false misses.
(6) cargo run rewrites <bin>.d, so every fresh run logs fresh-miss.
Add the missing tests. Also: STORY-79 and ADR-81 were marked completed before merge. The advisor reset them to in-progress; leave status changes to merge-time completion. Mail REWORK READY with the new head.
subject: aida-host PR #9 STORY-79: CHANGES round 1 (6 blocking); PR #8 is APPROVED, waiting on the operator's hold clear
